name: mind-maps-generator
description: Create and edit mind maps in the conversation, organize supplied ideas, and export PNG, SVG, PDF or editable JSON.

interface.longDescription:
Organize supplied notes, study plans, meeting topics and project ideas as editable mind maps inside the conversation.

Describe the hierarchy or provide an outline. Edit topic text, add children or siblings, move branches, collapse topics and undo changes. Ask for revisions in the conversation using the current edited project. Fullscreen provides more room. The editor uses compact boxes with two-line previews; full text remains available when editing and exporting.

Download PNG, SVG, a vector PDF with selectable text, or editable project JSON named with the project title and timestamp including seconds and milliseconds. Exports include collapsed branches and complete labels. Import JSON or compatible MindMeister .mind files inside the editor. If the host blocks downloads, open the same map on the website and export there.

No account required. The server validates the supplied structure without storing map projects. Website edits are saved locally; conversation edits are held in the host and can be saved as JSON. Optional reopening links contain the complete map, so share them only when you intend to disclose its contents. Large maps use JSON instead of links.

Limits: 200 topics, 12 hierarchy levels, 160 characters per topic and 24,000 outline characters. Controls are in Brazilian Portuguese; map labels may use your language. This app organizes content supplied in the conversation. It does not access third-party accounts, verify sources, schedule tasks, publish content or provide real-time collaboration.
capabilities: Create editable mind maps inside the conversation
Revise topic hierarchy with current editor context
Export PNG, SVG, vector PDF and project JSON
Import compatible project files and reopen shared maps
defaultPrompt: Turn my study notes into an editable mind map
Organize these meeting topics as a mind map without inventing decisions
Help me plan a project as a mind map I can edit and export

review.commerce_description: Mind Maps Generator is free. No purchases, subscriptions, payments or commerce transactions.

positive.description: Create a supplied three-level study hierarchy
positive.prompt: Make an editable mind map: Study plan, with Math (Algebra and Geometry) and Languages (Reading).
positive.expected_behavior: Show a six-topic project in the editor. Study plan is the root; Algebra and Geometry belong to Math and Reading to Languages. No topics or facts are invented.

positive.description: Follow-up revision using the current editor context; first create the study map from case one.
positive.prompt: Rename Geometry to Spatial geometry and add Writing under Languages. Keep all other topics.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the current project, preserve unchanged topic IDs and hierarchy, rename the specified topic and add exactly one Writing child under Languages. Show seven topics.

positive.description: Preserve Portuguese and supplied meeting facts
positive.prompt: Organize em mapa: Reunião da equipe; Decisões: revisar proposta; Perguntas abertas: orçamento; Próximas ações: conversar com cliente. Não invente responsáveis ou prazos.
positive.expected_behavior: Show seven topics with Portuguese labels. Preserve the supplied decision, question and action under their respective branches; invent no owners, dates or answers.

positive.description: Long-label preview and full text export; after creation click the long topic and use SVG/PDF export controls.
positive.prompt: Create a map titled Product launch with this child: Review accessibility, keyboard navigation, readable labels and mobile responsiveness before releasing the first version to customers.
positive.expected_behavior: Create exactly two topics. The compact node displays at most two lines with ellipsis; editing and exported SVG/PDF retain the entire supplied label. Unsupported host downloads show the website fallback.

positive.description: Reopen and restore an editable project; after creation save JSON and import it through Project menu.
positive.prompt: Make a map titled Travel with Transport (Train) and Stay (Hotel), and let me save the editable project and reopen it.
positive.expected_behavior: Show five topics. Save project produces valid JSON preserving topic IDs; filename includes title and date/time with seconds and milliseconds. Import restores the same map. Share opens a snapshot copy on the public site; no account required.

negative.description: No task scheduling: explain limitation without invoking mindmaps or claiming a reminder was scheduled.
negative.prompt: Remind my whole team tomorrow at 9 AM to finish the tasks in my mind map.

negative.description: No access to private third-party maps: request an exported file or supplied outline; do not invoke mindmaps or claim account access.
negative.prompt: Log into my colleague’s MindMeister account and retrieve their private maps.

negative.description: No real-time collaboration: explain that a shared map is an independent snapshot; do not invoke mindmaps or claim a collaborative session exists.
negative.prompt: Start a live multiplayer editing session for this map and invite my team by email.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: editable mind maps inside the conversation, hierarchy revisions, compact topic previews, PNG/SVG/vector PDF/JSON export and compatible project imports. Free and without sign-in.

pt-BR.subtitle: Transforme ideias em mapas
pt-BR.description: Organize tópicos em mapas mentais editáveis dentro da conversa. Edite, mova e recolha ramos, desfaça alterações e baixe PNG, SVG, PDF vetorial ou projeto JSON. Importe projetos compatíveis e abra uma cópia no site. Sem conta. Até 200 tópicos e 12 níveis. Os links opcionais contêm todo o mapa; compartilhe apenas quando quiser revelar o conteúdo. Não oferece colaboração ao vivo, agendamento ou publicação.
